author: BBC Earth
description:
After travelling up from 200m deep to feast on jellyfish, these giant ocean sunfish gather among floating kelp for a spot of pampering, as halfmoon fish pick off troublesome parasites. Then it's time to soak up the sun before disappearing back into the depths.

Blue Planet III returns to uncover extraordinary new stories and lives hidden beneath our oceans. Find out where to watch the full series 👉 https://www.bbcearth.com/shows/blue-planet-iii
